SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       SUM(r.points) AS total_prize_money
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2021
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY total_prize_money DESC;

FROM driverStandings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2021
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY total_points DESC;

FROM (
    SELECT rsl.driverId, SUM(rsl.points) AS total_points
    FROM results rsl
    JOIN races r ON rsl.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2020
    GROUP BY rsl.driverId
    HAVING total_points > 0
) AS driver_totals;

WITH european_races AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        r.raceId,
        c.name AS circuit_name,
        c.country
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
    AND c.country IN ('Spain', 'Italy', 'France', 'Germany', 'United Kingdom', 'Belgium', 'Netherlands', 'Monaco', 'Austria', 'Hungary', 'Portugal', 'Finland', 'Sweden', 'San Marino', 'Luxembourg')
),
yearly_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) AS num_races,
        SUM(rs.points) AS total_race_points
    FROM european_races er
    JOIN results rs ON er.raceId = rs.raceId
    GROUP BY year
),
yoy_comparison AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        total_race_points,
        LAG(total_race_points) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_points,
        ROUND(((total_race_points - LAG(total_race_points) OVER (ORDER BY year)) * 100.0) / 
              NULLIF(LAG(total_race_points) OVER (ORDER BY year), 0), 2) AS yoy_percentage_change
    FROM yearly_aggregates
)
SELECT yoy_percentage_change
FROM yoy_comparison
WHERE yoy_percentage_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY yoy_percentage_change DESC;

    FROM races r

    WHERE c.country IN ('United Kingdom','Germany','France','Italy','Spain','Monaco','Belgium','Netherlands','Switzerland','Austria','Hungary','Poland','Czech Republic','Russia','Turkey')
      AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
),
attendance_per_event_year AS (
    SELECT gp_name, year, SUM(attendance) AS total_attendance
    FROM euro_races
    GROUP BY gp_name, year
),
yoy AS (
    SELECT
        cur.gp_name,
        cur.year,
        CASE
            WHEN prev.total_attendance = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((cur.total_attendance - prev.total_attendance) * 100.0 / prev.total_attendance)
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM attendance_per_event_year cur
    LEFT JOIN attendance_per_event_year prev
        ON cur.gp_name = prev.gp_name
       AND cur.year = prev.year + 1
)
SELECT gp_name, year, growth_rate
FROM yoy
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, r.fastestLap, r.fastestLapTime
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE ra.year = 2021
  AND c.name LIKE '%Monaco%'
ORDER BY r.fastestLapSpeed DESC

WITH monaco AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.year = 2021
    AND r.name LIKE '%Monaco Grand Prix%'
)
SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       NULL AS tireCompound
FROM results res
JOIN monaco m ON res.raceId = m.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT con.name AS constructor,
       r.year AS season,

GROUP BY r.year, con.name
ORDER BY total_sponsorship_revenue DESC;

-- Note: The database schema does not contain fuel consumption data.
-- No table has columns related to fuel consumption or distance traveled.
-- Therefore, this query cannot return fuel consumption metrics.
-- Available data includes: race results, points, laps, time, etc.

SELECT 
    c.constructorRef AS constructor,
    r.year,
    ra.name AS race_name,
    AVG(cres.points) AS avg_points_per_race
FROM seasons s
INNER JOIN races ra ON s.year = ra.year
INNER JOIN constructorResults cres ON ra.raceId = cres.raceId
INNER JOIN constructors c ON cres.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE s.year = 2020
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.constructorRef, r.year, ra.name
ORDER BY AVG(cres.points) DESC;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name AS constructor_name,
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.round,
        NULL AS fuel_consumption_per_100km
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
    JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2020
),
race_agg AS (
    SELECT
        constructorId,
        constructor_name,
        raceId,
        race_name,
        AVG(fuel_consumption_per_100km) AS avg_fuel_per_100km_race
    FROM base
    GROUP BY constructorId, constructor_name, raceId, race_name
),
constructor_agg AS (
    SELECT
        constructorId,
        constructor_name,
        AVG(avg_fuel_per_100km_race) AS overall_avg_fuel_per_100km
    FROM race_agg
    GROUP BY constructorId, constructor_name
)
SELECT
    ra.constructor_name,
    ra.race_name,
    ra.avg_fuel_per_100km_race,
    ca.overall_avg_fuel_per_100km,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.overall_avg_fuel_per_100km DESC) AS season_rank
FROM race_agg ra
JOIN constructor_agg ca ON ra.constructorId = ca.constructorId
ORDER BY ra.constructor_name, ra.race_name;
